messages.text: List every object of these classes that is visible in the image: bathtub, bed, countertop, dishwasher, kettle, kitchen cabinet, microwave, refrigerator, sink, sofa, stove, toilet, wardrobe, washing machine. Answer with JSON only: a list of {"label": <one of the classes>, "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]} with coordinates scaled 0-1000 across the image width and height. Answer [] if none is visible. Do not list objects you cannot see.
